title: Tests still inherit GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE, so census tests can fetch into the real repository under a pre-push hook
goal: No test inherits the git variables a hook sets: conftest.py removes GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE (and GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY) from os.environ at import for the whole run, not only test_backlog.py; TestCensusInGit and TestCensusLedger run their git and census.py in the test's own repository; a test runs census.repo_dir's fetch with a planted GIT_DIR pointing at a scratch repository and asserts that repository is unchanged. The repro is a text check because the behaviour needs a pre-push hook's environment: the planted-GIT_DIR test is the behavioural proof. From the SP-z7a5c76b review: BG-q67lvp5b's fix covered test_backlog.py only (census.py:176 runs git fetch --force +refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*).

run: import pathlib,re,sys; t=pathlib.Path('_tools/conftest.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); head=t.split('def ',1)[0]; sys.exit(0 if all(v in head for v in ('GIT_DIR','GIT_WORK_TREE','GIT_INDEX_FILE')) else 1)
